about: Houli, Tajvan (id houli): the circuit at Yuemei in Houli district north of Taichung, opened 2018 (3.5 km, FIA grade 2), clockwise as raced, one lap (docs/dirkalisca-celine.md, »Novih pet«). The route: OSM's highway=raceway way 779852386, closed and one-way (its nodes in the driving order), on its own (no other way shares its nodes; not the karting track 669663588 and 669663840 in the infield, nor the raceway 1323087236 by it). The pits: no pit lane in OSM; the race building w1137180474 (5 floors, 321 m) on the right of the main straight, its front 20 m from the centre line; the grandstand w1137180475 on the left across the straight (tools/houli/build.py).
